    Generating an algebra modulo a nilpotent ideal #

    Vendored from TauCeti (TauCeti/Algebra/Algebra/Subalgebra/Nilpotent.lean, Apache 2.0, The Tau Ceti contributors), Mathlib-only, renamed into the namespace LargeIndecomposable.NilGen.

    If a subalgebra S maps onto A/I for a nilpotent two-sided ideal I and contains representatives spanning I/I², then S = A (eq_top_of_nilpotent_ideal); surjective_of_nilpotent_ideal is the version for algebra maps.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.NilGen.pow_le_toSubmodule_sup_pow_succ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : Subalgebra R A) (I : Ideal A) [I.IsTwoSided] (h : Submodule.restrictScalars R I ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ 2)) (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ n) ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ (n + 1))

    If a subalgebra contains representatives of the first ideal layer, it contains representatives of every positive ideal layer.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.NilGen.toSubmodule_sup_pow_restrictScalars_eq_top_of_le_sup_sq {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : Subalgebra R A) (I : Ideal A) [I.IsTwoSided] (hquot : Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R I = ⊤) (hlayer : Submodule.restrictScalars R I ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ 2)) (n : ℕ) :
    Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ n) = ⊤

    If a subalgebra maps onto the quotient by an ideal and contains representatives of its first ideal layer, it maps onto the quotient by every power of that ideal.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.NilGen.eq_top_of_nilpotent_ideal {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : Subalgebra R A) (I : Ideal A) [I.IsTwoSided] (hI : IsNilpotent I) (hquot : Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R I = ⊤) (hlayer : Submodule.restrictScalars R I ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule S ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ 2)) :
    S = ⊤

    A subalgebra is the whole algebra if it maps onto the quotient by a nilpotent two-sided ideal and contains representatives spanning the first ideal layer.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.NilGen.surjective_of_nilpotent_ideal {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_2} {B : Type u_3} [CommSemiring R] [Semiring A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (I : Ideal B) [I.IsTwoSided] (hI : IsNilpotent I) (hquot : Function.Surjective ⇑((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp f)) (hlayer : Submodule.restrictScalars R I ≤ Subalgebra.toSubmodule f.range ⊔ Submodule.restrictScalars R (I ^ 2)) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑f

    An algebra map is surjective if it is surjective modulo a nilpotent two-sided ideal and its range contains representatives spanning the first ideal layer.
